sections.name: Braids & Cornrows
sections.description: Box braids, knotless, Fulani, cornrows and other braided protective styles.

looks.title: Medium Knotless Box Braids
looks.text: medium knotless box braids hanging past the shoulder blades, flat painless roots, square parts, tips dipped and sealed

looks.title: Waist-Length Box Braids
looks.text: waist-length medium box braids with crisp square parts, swinging loose down the back, a few gold cuffs scattered through

looks.title: Jumbo Box Braids
looks.text: chunky jumbo box braids in big square sections, shoulder-to-mid-back length, bold and quick to swing

looks.title: Micro Braids
looks.text: hundreds of fine micro braids, flowing and light, moving almost like loose hair

looks.title: Bohemian Knotless Braids
looks.text: boho knotless braids with loose curly human-hair pieces left out along the lengths and curly ends, soft and textured

looks.title: Fulani Braids
looks.text: Fulani-style braids: a cornrow down the centre of the head, side cornrows curving toward the face, long braids at the back, wooden and gold beads threaded on

looks.title: Lemonade Side Braids
looks.text: long thin cornrow-style braids all swept to one side, small zig-zag parts, braids falling over one shoulder

looks.title: Triangle-Part Box Braids
looks.text: shoulder-length box braids with sharp triangle parts in a geometric pattern across the scalp

looks.title: Braided Bob
looks.text: chin-length box braids cut into a blunt bob, ends sealed, swinging just above the jaw

looks.title: Straight-Back Cornrows
looks.text: neat straight-back cornrows from hairline to nape, even parts, edges laid smooth

looks.title: Stitch Braids
looks.text: feed-in stitch braids in six thick straight-back rows, horizontal stitch lines along each braid, ends hanging long

looks.title: Feed-In Braided Ponytail
looks.text: feed-in cornrows sweeping up into a high braided ponytail, sleek edges, ponytail of long box braids

looks.title: Halo Crown Braid
looks.text: a single thick braid wrapped around the head like a crown, ends tucked, soft baby hairs at the temples

looks.title: Goddess Braids
looks.text: large goddess cornrows curving back from the hairline in sweeping arcs, finished in a low bun

looks.title: Tribal Braids with Cuffs
looks.text: cornrows mixed with free-hanging braids, silver cuffs and thread wraps on a few braids, cowrie shells at the ends

looks.title: Men's Braids with Fade
looks.text: thin straight-back cornrows on top, sides taken down to a low fade, braids reaching the nape

looks.title: Pop Smoke Braids
looks.text: two-strand braided zig-zag pattern on top, short braids hanging to the nape, clean taper at the sides

sections.name: Twists & Locs
sections.description: Two-strand, Senegalese and passion twists, faux locs and natural locs.

looks.title: Two-Strand Twists
looks.text: medium two-strand twists on natural hair, defined and springy, falling to the jaw

looks.title: Mini Twists
looks.text: tiny two-strand twists on natural hair, full and dense, worn loose with a side part

looks.title: Senegalese Twists
looks.text: long sleek Senegalese rope twists, smooth and glossy, hanging to mid-back

looks.title: Passion Twists
looks.text: bohemian passion twists, loose and fluffy with a curly texture, shoulder to bra-strap length

looks.title: Marley Twists
looks.text: chunky Marley twists with a matte, kinky texture, full and voluminous, falling past the shoulders

looks.title: Spring Twists
looks.text: short bouncy spring twists, coiled and springy, sitting around the jaw like a curly bob

looks.title: Flat Twists Updo
looks.text: flat twists running back from the hairline into a twisted bun at the crown

looks.title: Faux Locs
looks.text: long faux locs with a slightly rough, natural finish, a few wrapped in gold thread

looks.title: Goddess Locs
looks.text: goddess faux locs with curly ends and loose curls peeking out along the length, soft and romantic

looks.title: Butterfly Locs
looks.text: distressed butterfly locs with little looped bumps all along them, shoulder length and airy

looks.title: Starter Locs
looks.text: young starter locs from comb coils, short, neat and evenly parted, still a little fuzzy

looks.title: Shoulder-Length Locs
looks.text: mature locs of even width, shoulder length, worn loose with a middle part

looks.title: Long Locs Half-Up
looks.text: long mature locs, the top half gathered into a loc bun at the crown, the rest falling down the back

looks.title: Loc Petal Updo
looks.text: locs pinned up into a sculpted petal bun, a few loose locs framing the face

looks.title: Microlocs
looks.text: hundreds of fine microlocs, versatile and swingy, curled at the ends with a rod set

looks.title: Freeform Locs
looks.text: thick freeform locs of uneven widths, organic and textured, tied back loosely

looks.title: Locs with Cuffs and Shells
looks.text: mid-length locs decorated with silver cuffs, wooden beads and cowrie shells

looks.title: Sponge Twists
looks.text: short sponge-brushed twists on top, small coiled nubs, clean taper at the sides

looks.title: Barrel Twists
looks.text: thick barrel-twisted locs pulled back into a low ponytail, sides tapered

sections.name: Natural Hair
sections.description: Afros, puffs, twist-outs, wash-and-gos and other natural styles.

looks.title: TWA
looks.text: a teeny weeny afro, close-cropped natural coils, soft and even all over

looks.title: Rounded Afro
looks.text: a full rounded afro picked out into a soft halo shape, airy and voluminous

looks.title: Big Picked-Out Afro
looks.text: a large picked-out afro with huge volume, a wooden afro pick tucked in at the side

looks.title: High Puff
looks.text: natural hair gathered into one high puff at the crown, edges brushed smooth

looks.title: Double Afro Puffs
looks.text: two round afro puffs high on either side of a centre part, edges laid

looks.title: Twist-Out
looks.text: a defined twist-out, coils stretched and separated into soft, juicy spirals, full shape

looks.title: Braid-Out
looks.text: a stretched braid-out with crimped, wavy definition and lots of body

looks.title: Bantu Knots
looks.text: neat Bantu knots in triangle sections across the head, small coiled buns

looks.title: Bantu Knot-Out
looks.text: a Bantu knot-out with springy, spiral curls and a defined, bouncy shape

looks.title: Wash-and-Go
looks.text: a wash-and-go with clumped, glossy coils, defined from root to tip, shrinkage embraced

looks.title: Defined Curls with Laid Edges
looks.text: defined 3C curls fluffed at the roots, edges laid in swirling waves

looks.title: Tapered Natural Cut
looks.text: a tapered natural cut, coils fuller on top and cropped close at the sides and nape

looks.title: Frohawk
looks.text: a curly frohawk, coils piled high down the centre, sides pinned flat or twisted back

looks.title: Pineapple Updo
looks.text: natural curls gathered loosely at the very top of the head in a pineapple, curls spilling forward

looks.title: Finger Coils
looks.text: finger-coiled short natural hair, every coil defined and glossy

looks.title: Afro with Silk Headband
looks.text: a soft rounded afro pushed back with a wide silk headband in a bold print

looks.title: Curly Fro with Gold Clips
looks.text: a fluffy curly fro with a deep side part, a row of small gold clips above one ear

sections.name: Pressed & Sleek
sections.description: Silk presses, finger waves, sleek buns and other smooth styles.

looks.title: Silk Press
looks.text: a fresh silk press, natural hair flat-ironed bone-straight and glossy, swinging with movement, ends trimmed blunt

looks.title: Silk Press with Bump
looks.text: a silk press with a big bouncy bump curl at the ends and a deep side part

looks.title: Finger Waves
looks.text: sculpted finger waves set close to the head in glossy S-shaped ridges, short and sleek

looks.title: Short Relaxed Pixie
looks.text: a short relaxed pixie, sides cropped close, top layered and laid in soft waves

looks.title: Sleek Bob with Laid Edges
looks.text: a sleek chin-length bob, pressed straight with a centre part, baby hairs laid in swirls

looks.title: Slicked-Back Bun
looks.text: hair slicked back into a low, tight bun with a glossy finish and sculpted edges

looks.title: Genie Ponytail
looks.text: a sleek high genie ponytail with long straight extensions, wrapped base and laid edges

looks.title: Swoop Bang Ponytail
looks.text: a sleek ponytail with a dramatic side-swept swoop bang across the forehead

looks.title: Body-Wave Lace Front
looks.text: a body-wave lace front wig, long glossy waves, middle part and melted lace

looks.title: Quick Weave Bob
looks.text: a quick weave bob with a sharp angle, longer in front, glossy and straight

looks.title: Pin Curls Set
looks.text: vintage pin curls set and brushed out into soft glamorous waves

looks.title: 360 Waves
looks.text: deep 360 waves brushed into tight rippling rings all over, short and even, crisp line-up

looks.title: Caesar with Line-Up
looks.text: a short Caesar cut, even all over with a straight fringe line, sharp edge-up at the hairline

looks.title: Low Fade with Waves
looks.text: short wavy top with a low skin fade at the temples and nape, razor-sharp line-up

looks.title: High-Top Fade
looks.text: a tall flat-topped high-top fade, sides skin-faded, top sculpted into a crisp box

looks.title: Temple Fade Afro
looks.text: a short rounded afro on top with a temple fade and a clean beard line

looks.title: Burst Fade Mohawk
looks.text: a curly mohawk strip down the centre with a burst fade curving around the ears

looks.title: Buzz Cut with Part
looks.text: a close buzz cut with a shaved hard part on one side and a crisp line-up

looks.title: Short Coils with Skin Fade
looks.text: defined short coils on top, a high skin fade on the sides and back

looks.title: Tied-Up Locs
looks.text: shoulder-length locs gathered into a high loc bun, sides tapered

looks.title: Twisted Mohawk
looks.text: two-strand twists running down the centre in a mohawk shape, sides faded short

sections.name: Wraps, Bonnets & Night
sections.description: Headwraps, scarves, bonnets and durags, for going out or going to bed.

looks.title: Satin Bonnet
looks.text: hair tucked away under a big satin bonnet for the night, a few edges peeking out at the front

looks.title: Silk Scarf Wrap
looks.text: hair wrapped for sleep in a silk scarf tied at the front, smooth and secure

looks.title: Pineapple Under a Bonnet
looks.text: curls pineappled loosely at the crown and covered with a roomy satin bonnet overnight

looks.title: Twisted for Bed
looks.text: hair in large chunky twists for the night, ready to unravel into a twist-out in the morning

looks.title: Silk Durag
looks.text: a silky durag tied snugly over 360 waves, long tails down the back

looks.title: Velvet Durag
looks.text: a velvet durag in a rich jewel tone, tails tied behind, worn out as a statement

looks.title: Tall Headwrap
looks.text: a tall sculpted headwrap in bold printed fabric, wrapped high with a knot at the front

looks.title: Puff with Headwrap
looks.text: a natural puff bursting out of a twisted fabric headwrap tied at the front

looks.title: Braids Under a Wrap
looks.text: long braids gathered into a bun and partly covered by a printed silk wrap, a few braids hanging loose
